words.prose: {{ar:مَرَجَ}} ({{tr:maraja}}) opens the ayah as a completed finite act that directly governs {{ar:ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ}} ({{tr:al-baḥrayni}}). Its Form I perfect gives the initial force to the release, while the following asyndetic imperfect clause shows the continuing meeting-state that results. The missing 3ms subject keeps the agent supplied by the surrounding divine discourse, but attachment evidence warns that the grammar itself does not name one forced antecedent. Lexically, the two-sea collocation selects release or letting loose, while the root's mixing and agitation range keeps the scene from becoming flat motion: the seas are set loose into a controlled boundary encounter. The same opening phrase in 25:53 is expanded with qualities and barrier language, so 55:19 reads as the compressed version: act, dual object, meeting. Within Surah 55, the root also touches mixed flame (55:15) and sea-product imagery (55:22; 55:58), making this verb part of a local material thread without turning the verb itself into a noun or product.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ}} ({{tr:al-baḥrayni}}) is the ayah's hinge. Its definite dual form makes the scene exactly two identifiable seas, and attachment evidence resolves the -ayni form here as the governed object of {{ar:مَرَجَ}} ({{tr:maraja}}), not as a genitive or loose phrase. The noun then turns forward: the same pair supplies the controlled subject agreement for {{ar:يَلْتَقِيَانِ}} ({{tr:yaltaqiyāni}}), so the seas move from affected object to participants in meeting. The root keeps the scale large: locally these are literal seas, yet the broad-expanse range makes the object feel like vastness counted as two. Other dual-sea passages specify the pair differently, including journey (18:60), sweet and bitter qualities (25:53), barrier (27:61), and unequal waters (35:12); 55:19 leaves the pair unnamed and lets release plus meeting define them. The same dual noun also prepares the between-them relation in 55:20 and participates in the audible dual cadence with the final verb.

words.prose: {{ar:يَلْتَقِيَانِ}} ({{tr:yaltaqiyāni}}) closes the ayah by making the two seas the grammatical actors of meeting. The dual agreement prevents the pair from collapsing into one collective mass, and the built-in subject means the final word does not need to repeat {{ar:ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ}} ({{tr:al-baḥrayni}}). Its imperfect, retained final nūn, and direct attachment to the preceding noun present the meeting as an asserted ongoing state rather than a purpose clause or later sequence. Form VIII gives the contact mutual shape: the seas face one another in reciprocal encounter, while the broader root range keeps the result unspecified as contact, not named merger, peace, or battle. Against 25:53, where the same sea-release opening moves toward barrier and prohibition, 55:19 ends on meeting; against the flood-water meeting in 54:12, this is ordered cosmological contact. The final dual cadence also transfers the surrounding dual sound from the addressees in 55:18 to the two seas, and the meeting statement prepares the between-them articulation in 55:20.

topics.reason: The imperfect indicative dual with retained nūn is locally analyzed as a circumstantial verbal clause describing the state of the two seas.

topics.headline: mutual encounter without named outcome
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the contact itself: two expanses meet face-to-face, while the wording does not say they merge or fight.
topics.reason: The local Form VIII meeting selects reciprocal encounter, while other root branches such as casting, receiving, hostile clash, or eschatological meeting remain range context rather than the direct local sense.

topics.headline: released objects become meeting agents

topics.reason: The same dual entity is object of the first verb and syntactically controlled subject of the final meeting verb.

topics.headline: attached state with possible characterizing force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final clause clings to the noun: the seas are released as meeting, and the wording can also characterize them as the pair that meet.
topics.reason: The attachment data strongly licenses a circumstantial clause; adjectival or characterizing force is retained only as a close secondary reading because no connector separates the clause from the noun.

topics.headline: meeting distinguished from barrier and flood
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 55:19 specializes the shared sea-release scene toward meeting, contrasting with barrier language in 25:53 and catastrophic water meeting in 54:12.
topics.reason: The cited cross-references are concrete and the local closing verb makes meeting the distinguishing emphasis of 55:19.

topics.headline: dual meeting is heard at closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that duality is not only parsed; the final ending lets the paired meeting be heard as the ayah closes.
topics.reason: The final dual ending and the matching dual noun ending are local surface features, and the boundary rows support the shift from second-person dual address in 55:18 to third-person dual seas.

topics.reason: Distributional evidence marks this exact Form VIII water-meeting use as low occurrence and tightly tied to the sea noun.

topics.reason: The next-ayah bridge is a structural payoff of the meeting clause and does not require adding a new sense to the verb.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The perfect transitive first verb acts on a dual object, while the imperfect reciprocal final verb presents their encounter as ongoing.
baseline_models.mechanism: An agent releases two extensive mobile domains and thereby establishes a continuing face-to-face process rather than reporting a static location.

activation_trace.role: Released grazing supplies the literal letting-loose image and functions as the initiating motion.
Wide abundant water supplies the two extensive moving domains acted upon.
Two things coming face to face supplies reciprocal encounter and functions as the ongoing result.

changed_reading.before: Two seas happen to be at a meeting place.
changed_reading.after: The two expanses are deliberately let range into an ongoing mutual encounter.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The dual noun and dual verb keep two participants grammatically present throughout the meeting.
baseline_models.mechanism: Mobility within place brings two broad domains into opposition and adjacency without requiring either participant to lose its identity.

activation_trace.role: Looseness within a place supplies local mobility while retaining a containing locale.
Expanse and breadth supply two domains large enough to touch without becoming one object.
Face-to-face encounter preserves opposed participants and functions as contact without necessary fusion.

changed_reading.before: Meeting means that the two seas merge into one mass.
changed_reading.after: The two mobile expanses attain real adjacency while remaining a grammatical and functional pair.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The release verb can activate disorder and interlacing, while the final verb can activate the bringing together of two sides.
baseline_models.mechanism: The encounter zone may be an active braided or turbulent interface: expansive motions tangle and align locally even if the two domains persist.

activation_trace.role: Confused disorder supplies instability and functions as turbulent mixing at the encounter.
Tangling and crooked interlacing supply a braided material geometry for the interface.
Breadth supplies the large fields across which local turbulence can occur.
Making two sides meet supplies edge alignment and functions as the local joining operation.

changed_reading.before: The seas meet along a placid geometric line.
changed_reading.after: Their meeting may be a moving, interlaced contact zone whose turbulence does not settle the question of merger.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Focus branches extend breadth to knowledge and speech, meeting to receiving speech, and release to confused affairs or covenants.
baseline_models.mechanism: Alongside the material scene, two extensive bodies of discourse can be released into mutual reception, where encounter risks either communication or confusion.

activation_trace.role: Disorder in affairs, religion, and covenants supplies the risk produced when domains of meaning intermingle.
Breadth in knowledge and speech supplies the two nonmaterial expanses.
Receiving or imparting speech supplies a communicative mode of meeting and functions as reciprocal uptake.

changed_reading.before: The ayah can only describe physical waters.
changed_reading.after: It can also model two broad fields of meaning entering reciprocal reception, with confusion remaining a live risk.

context_deltas.mechanism: Teaching and recitation precede disclosure by speech, while the disclosure root later names the relation between the seas; this revises discursive meeting from confused mixture into contrast that can make meaning legible.

activation_trace.role: Breadth in knowledge and speech keeps the changed reading anchored in the two focus expanses.
Receiving and imparting speech keeps the changed reading anchored in the focus encounter.
Disclosure to a knower supplies an epistemic direction for the encounter.
Reading and recitation supply the communicated material that can be received.
Revealing meaning through speech or sign supplies clarification as a possible outcome of relation.
A connection standing between endpoints turns spatial betweenness into the relational carrier of disclosure.

structural_cues: 55:2-4 sequences teaching, recitation, human formation, and disclosure before the physical pair appears.
The root used for disclosure at 55:4 recurs in the between-construction at 55:20.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies teaching, recitation, disclosure, and a later between-relation from one root. I infer that preserved contrast can enable intelligibility; alternatively the communicative and spatial senses are independent local uses.

changed_reading.before: Discursive expanses meet chiefly as a risk of confused mixture.
changed_reading.after: Their maintained between-relation can become the very condition by which one field receives, distinguishes, and clarifies another.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier balance sequence supplies alignment, justice, and a ban on exceeding limits; the next ayah supplies an intermediate relation and denies mutual overrun. Release therefore operates inside a calibrated boundary regime.

activation_trace.role: Letting animals range supplies genuine freedom of motion that calibration must govern rather than cancel.
Face-to-face encounter supplies real contact rather than remote separation.
Balancing and aligning two things supplies calibration between the released domains.
Exceeding a limit in rebellion supplies the prohibited mode of crossing.
Justice and equity supply the norm that keeps reciprocal contact non-dominating.
The middle interval between two things supplies a positive contact zone rather than mere distance.
Aggressive transgression beyond a limit supplies the action explicitly withheld from both participants.

structural_cues: 55:7-9 moves from a placed balance to commands against excess and deficient measure.
55:20 inserts a barzakh in the middle and predicates non-overrun of both members of the pair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies alignment, limits, equity, an intermediate barzakh, and non-transgression. I infer that these form the operating rule of the focus encounter; alternatively the balance passage is an ethical analogy and 55:20 only adds a physical obstruction.

changed_reading.before: Letting the seas meet suggests unbounded mixing or a barrier that stops encounter.
changed_reading.after: A calibrated middle permits active contact while preventing either expanse from overriding the other.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired rising and setting limits, followed by paired kinds, make duality functional: distinct counterparts define a field through opposition and relation rather than through duplication.

activation_trace.role: Two breadths supply the paired field whose members remain extensive in their own right.
Face-to-face meeting makes counterpart relation, rather than mere numerical doubling, the focus action.
Light rising from the east supplies one directional pole in the preceding dual horizon.
Sunset in the west supplies the opposed directional pole and functions as a model of complementarity.
A counterpart joined to its counterpart supplies later confirmation that pairing preserves two related members.

structural_cues: 55:17, 55:19, 55:46, 55:50, 55:52, 55:62, and 55:66 repeatedly organize scenes through dual forms.
The focus uses a dual object and a dual reciprocal predicate rather than a singular collective.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated duals whose members are directional poles, waters, gardens, springs, or paired kinds. I infer a surah-level design of productive counterpart relation; alternatively each dual serves only its local scene.

changed_reading.before: The two seas are an unspecified duplicate pair.
changed_reading.after: They are distinct counterparts whose opposition and encounter jointly define a relational field, without importing a fixed identity for either sea.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after bounded meeting, hidden material comes outward as luminous treasure, and the marjan outcome reactivates the focus release root. The interface can therefore be read as productive rather than merely restrictive.

activation_trace.role: Abundant water supplies the material domains from which the later yield is said to come.
Reciprocal encounter supplies the candidate interaction that precedes emergence.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies emergence and functions as conversion of latent content into visible yield.
Glittering radiance supplies the perceptible value of what emerges.
The jewel or bead sense of marjan loops the named output back to the focus release root.

structural_cues: 55:22 follows the meeting and barzakh sequence and attributes the output to the dual source.
The focus verb and one named output recur under the same packet root inventory.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sequence, dual-source grammar, emergence from concealment, and a root echo in the yield. I infer that bounded interaction enables production; alternatively each sea yields independently and the root echo is incidental wordplay.

changed_reading.before: The meeting is an endpoint whose only issue is whether the waters mix.
changed_reading.after: The bounded encounter is also a generative interface from which previously hidden value becomes manifest.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later vocabulary distinguishes arriving face to face from passing clean through a domain: penetration across its sides is a separate operation conditioned by effective authority.

activation_trace.role: Face-to-face arrival supplies encounter without itself asserting passage to the far side.
A wide cleft supplies a boundary geometry across which passage would be a distinct act.
Clean passage to the other side supplies the stronger operation that the focus meeting does not entail.
Sides and regions supply the domain edges through which attempted transit is measured.
Power and authority supply the condition for trans-domain passage, unlike ordinary contact.

structural_cues: 55:33 repeats the penetration verb three times across the regions of heaven and earth and denies it without authority.
The focus predicates mutual meeting, not entry, crossing, or arrival on the opposite side.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies distinct lexemes for meeting and through-passage, plus edges and conditional power. I infer a difference between contact and permeability; alternatively the later eschatological challenge has no bearing on the marine interface.

changed_reading.before: If the seas really meet, each must pass freely into the other.
changed_reading.after: Mutual contact can be real while trans-boundary penetration remains a separate, constrained operation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later paired gardens contain paired water sources that flow or surge and paired kinds of fruit. Repeated doubled sources strengthen the reading that maintained twoness is a productive design rather than a temporary defect awaiting merger.

activation_trace.role: Two abundant waters anchor the later garden pattern back in the focus pair.
Mutual encounter supplies relation between the paired sources without singularizing them.
A spring as the source of running water supplies a smaller-scale echo of the focus waters.
Continuous flowing supplies ongoing motion within the first paired garden scene.
A counterpart joined to its counterpart supplies productive pairing in the resulting abundance.
The repeated pair of water sources confirms that doubled flow is an intentional recurring form.
Abundant surging water varies the mode of flow while preserving the two-source pattern.

structural_cues: Two gardens at 55:46 and another two at 55:62 each contain two springs at 55:50 and 55:66.
55:52 places paired kinds of every fruit inside the first doubled garden structure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated dual gardens, dual water sources, distinct flow modes, and paired produce. I infer that preserved pairing generates differentiated abundance; alternatively these are independent features of the garden descriptions.

changed_reading.before: The two seas form one exceptional marine juxtaposition.
changed_reading.after: Their maintained duality participates in a recurring architecture where paired sources remain distinct and support abundance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it transfers a flaring-fire morphology into a water scene. It remains anchored by the same focus release root, the immediately preceding fire occurrence, literal broad water, and reciprocal contact; downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for a turbulent interface, never as a claim that the seas are fire or as a scientific identification.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus release root has a flaring-fire branch, while the sea and meeting roots retain broad water and face-to-face contact.

activation_trace.role: A flaring, radiating flame supplies folded energetic motion and functions as the shape of the contact front.
Wide abundant water keeps the transferred motion anchored in the literal marine domains.
Face-to-face encounter locates the fiery motion at the interface between two waters.
The preceding occurrence explicitly activates the same root's flame branch before the focus reuse.
Blazing fire confirms the elemental source of the transferred turbulence image.

changed_reading.before: Two water bodies touch along a visually inert boundary.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, their interface behaves like interfolding tongues or rays of fluid motion while each broad medium remains present.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because conception, containment, miscarriage, and pregnancy are form-distant branches rather than the ordinary senses of the ayah, and one branch introduces failed generation. It remains anchored in the focus meeting and release inventories and in the immediate emergence sequence; downstream prose must label it a speculative gestational analogy, not a translation, biological referent, or resolved interpretation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus branches combine swift conception at meeting, a water-holding place, and the fragile casting of formed life under the release root.

activation_trace.role: Swift conception supplies generative encounter as the outlier's initiating relation.
Water-holding ground supplies a containing medium in which interaction can develop.
Casting a formed fetus supplies fragility and prevents the generative model from becoming automatically successful.
Emergence from concealment supplies the transition from hidden process to visible outcome.
Conception and developing pregnancy supply a branch-distant image of formation after encounter.

changed_reading.before: The meeting only establishes a spatial relation between waters.
changed_reading.after: As a contained outlier, the sequence can carry a fragile gestational template: paired contributions meet, hidden formation begins, and an outcome may emerge or fail.

strongest_changes: The balance and non-transgression sequence changes free mixing into calibrated contact within a positive middle.
The immediate emergence of pearl and marjan changes the meeting from an endpoint into a potentially productive interface.
The later penetration challenge distinguishes real encounter from unrestricted passage across a domain.
summary.what_was_special: The focus alone sustained agentive release, preserved duality, turbulent interlacing, and reciprocal reception. Context sharpened these without collapsing them, while root recurrence opened communicative, elemental, and generative readings that remain explicitly contained.
remaining_uncertainties: The ayah does not identify the two seas more narrowly, so no specific freshwater, saltwater, geographic, or cosmic pair is selected here.
It remains uncertain whether the later yield is caused by the interface or independently attributed to both waters.
The exact permeability of the middle is unresolved: contact, constrained exchange, and blocked overrun can coexist without specifying a physical mechanism.
The discursive, fire-fluid, and gestational activations are branch analogies, not lexical replacements for the marine reading.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Release ordered toward encounter.** `م ر ج/B001` gives release into open movement; the dual seas and `ل ق ي` meeting provide the structural cue. I infer that release enables encounter rather than implying chaotic fusion. The ayah reads as directed freedom.
2. **Potential mixture held in suspense.** `م ر ج/B004` supplies confused mixture, but 55:20 immediately inserts an interval and denies transgression. I infer that the branch is activated as a prevented possibility. The ayah therefore reads with productive tension: meeting approaches mixture, while the next ayah preserves distinction.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 55:22 makes valuable forms emerge from the pair. The later output shows that protected encounter is generative, correcting any reading of the boundary as mere prohibition.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **`م ر ج` `B004` — “mixing or confused interpenetration,” `ب ح ر` `B001` — “broad water,” and `ل ق ي` `B010` — “cause two sides to meet.”** Structural cue: the causative opening is followed by a dual reciprocal encounter, while 55:20 inserts an interval and denies overstepping. Assigned role: mixing supplies contact; caused meeting supplies convergence; the next ayah supplies regulation. Packet evidence is the verb sequence and immediate boundary clause. Inference: productive interaction requires controlled interface rather than homogeneous merger. Reading change: the two seas form a managed contact system.

2. **`م ر ج` `B005` — “looseness or release.”** Structural cue: release is immediately qualified by `يَلْتَقِيَانِ` and then by a non-transgressed barrier. Assigned role: this branch makes motion possible while assigning the barrier the limiting role. Packet evidence is the accepted image plus the next ayah’s syntax; inference: freedom of movement and preserved identity are complementary conditions. Reading change: the ayah can describe bounded release alongside the `B004` mixing image; neither reading is selected over the other.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 55:22 sharpened controlled contact into productive contact: valuable outputs emerge after the non-transgressed interface, supporting the regulation inference.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi işlerin, inanç düzeninin, sözlerin ve emanetlerin karışıp bozulması, düzensizleşmesi ve çıkış yolunun belirsizleşmesi üzerinde birleşir. Güç bir kargaşa ve sözünü tutmama sonuçları bu soyut çekirdeğe bağlıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal soyut düzenin karışıp bozulmasını kapsar; fiziksel gevşeklik, dal dolaşıklığı veya otlak anlamına genişlemez.

concept_map.definition: Bir işin, düşünce düzeninin, sözleşmenin veya emanet düzeninin karışıp düzensizleşmesi, bozulması ve doğru çıkış yolunun belirsizleşmesidir. Sözleşme ve emanetlerde bu durum sözünü tutmama ve güvenin zedelenmesiyle görünür.

Sözleşme ve emanetlerde karışıklığın bozulma, sözünü tutmama ve güven kaybı olarak ortaya çıkmasıdır.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal atma ve bir hedefe yöneltme eylemidir; atılmış nesnenin kalıcı adı veya karşılıklı buluşma değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak atma eylemi ile sevgi yöneltme ve çözülecek söz sunma gibi kalıba bağlı kullanımlar ayrı belirtilir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi bulunduğu yerden atmak, bırakmak veya belirli bir alıcıya yöneltmektir. Sevgi yöneltme ve çözülmesi istenen bir sözü birine sunma, bu hareketin kalıplaşmış kullanımlarıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Bu dal packet düzeyinde inceleme statüsünde tutulmuş sınır-riskli malzemeyi taşır. Kanıt, tek bir yalın kök imgesinden çok biçime veya özel kullanıma bağlı dağınık adlandırmaları gösterdiği için dal yapısal bölme şartı koşmadan sınırlı bir adlandırma kümesi olarak okunmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kapsam verilen biçim veya özel kullanım sınırıyla bağlıdır; ortak bir yalın anlam ya da üretken genel kullanım varsayılmaz.

facets.statement: Coğrafi kullanım dağ kenarlarındaki çıkıntıları veya iki dağ arasındaki birleşim yerini adlandırır.
Anatomik kullanım rahim ağzındaki dalları ve daha aşağıdaki dar geçitleri adlandırır.
Coğrafi aktarım koşullu olarak sorgulanır ve benzer bir biçimin ilk ünsüzü kökün parçası sayılarak bu kökten ayrılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: İnceleme statüsündeki kanıt, tek bir birleşik anlamdan çok biçime veya özel bağlama bağlı sınırlı adlandırmaları gösterir; dal bu kayıtları kontrollü biçimde görünür tutar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bu karşılık, kanıttaki dağınık veya biçime bağlı adlandırma kümesini güvenli biçimde etiketler; tek ve birleşik bir sözlük anlamı değildir.
